name: Splatt3R
definition: A feed-forward model that takes two uncalibrated images as input and outputs 3D Gaussian parameters for geometry and appearance, without requiring camera intrinsics, extrinsics, or depth.
summary: Splatt3R is a feed-forward method that predicts 3D Gaussian Splat primitives directly from uncalibrated image pairs, supporting extrapolation to wider baselines.
